reason: User-requested viability assessment adds inverse-message ambiguity to forward-production obligations. Toy equations demonstrate both readable differential channels and multiple messages with the same fixed forward rules; no manuscript data tested. Success levels distinguish technical fit, provisional content and independent semantic confirmation. No Latin or phonetic default; original reviews preserved.

blockers.detail: Need a finite writing/information contract and a whole-scope content attempt with alternative messages and their surviving distinctions. Forward reconstruction alone does not identify the read message or meaning. No confirmed word is required before hypothesis development.

not_sufficient: Lossless differential representation or compression alone
Free literals, resets or per-occurrence meanings
Availability of Latin resources or Latin-looking output
A finite forward writer without analysis of competing read messages
